description: A Minecraft mod that will jack (pull) to your inventory from any container when hovering an item in JEI

mods.name: JackItToMe
mods.description: Hover any item, press G, one of that item lands in your inventory - pulled from whatever container is open. Shift+G pulls a full stack, Ctrl+G pulls as much as fits. Also adds a button on every JEI recipe view that pulls all ingredients at once. With AE2, Refined Storage, or Integrated Dynamics installed, missing ingredients can be autocrafted: the native amount-selection popup opens for each missing-but-craftable item, pre-filled with the shortfall. Supports vanilla containers, AE2 ME networks, Refined Storage grids, and Integrated Dynamics storage terminals (with autocrafting via Integrated Crafting).

releases.notes:
# JackItToMe 1.1.0

A security fix. Update if you run this mod on a server.

## Fixed

- **Duplication through crafting result slots.** Hovering the result slot of a
  crafting table and pressing the pull key handed you the result without using
  up the ingredients in the grid. The same applied to every output slot that
  only previews a result: the 2x2 inventory grid, anvil, smithing table,
  stonecutter, loom, grindstone, cartography table and villager trades. These
  slots are no longer treated as a source, so the pull key and the recipe
  button leave them alone. Chests, furnaces and the other storage you pull from
  are unaffected.

releases.notes:
# JackItToMe 1.0.0

First stable release. The feature set has settled and the mod does what it set
out to do, so it leaves 0.x behind.

## The recipe button

The button that pulls every ingredient for a recipe now works the same whether
you use JEI, EMI or REI.

- **It shows up on EMI.** EMI hides mod-added recipe widgets behind a setting
  that is off by default, which left the button invisible for most EMI players.
  It no longer depends on that setting.
- **It no longer covers the recipe.** On EMI and REI the button sits in a strip
  beside the recipe rather than inside it. Short recipes such as anvil, fuel and
  AE2's P2P attunement used to have the button land on top of their contents.
- **Its tooltip opens beside the button** on EMI and REI, instead of over the
  recipe, so the red and green markers showing which ingredients are missing
  stay visible while you read it.
- **It is hidden when there is nothing to pull** - when you open a recipe with
  only your own inventory behind it.
- New hand-drawn icon, with a hover state.

## Configuration

A client config, under Mods -> JackItToMe -> Config:

- `showRecipeButton` - whether the recipe button is shown. The G keybinds are
  unaffected and keep working with it off.
- `buttonOffsetX` / `buttonOffsetY` - move the button from its default spot.
  EMI and REI only; JEI decides where its own recipe buttons go.
- `placementKeys` - opt in to moving the button in-game with Ctrl and the arrow
  keys, Ctrl+Home to reset. Each nudge is saved, so you can turn it back off
  once the button sits where you want it. EMI and REI only.

releases.notes:
## JackItToMe 0.7.0 — Rebindable pull keybinds & a smarter recipe button

### ⌨️ New default keybind: G (was P)

P collided with vanilla's Social Interactions screen and made the modifier
combos a two-handed stretch. **Existing installs keep their current binding**
— only fresh installs get G.

The quantities are now **three separate keybinds**, each rebindable under
**Options → Controls → JackItToMe**:

| Keybind (default) | Effect |
| ----------------- | ------ |
| **G**       | Pull one of the hovered item |
| **Shift+G** | Pull a full stack |
| **Ctrl+G**  | Pull as much as fits |

### 🔘 The recipe button learned the same modifiers

| Click | Effect |
| ----- | ------ |
| **Click** | Pull the recipe's amounts — if anything is missing, only opens autocraft popups so you can review before committing |
| **Alt+Click** | Pull what's in stock anyway (rebindable: *Pull in-stock override*) |
| **Shift+Click** | Pull materials for a **full stack of the output** |
| **Ctrl+Click** | Pull as many complete crafts as your storage holds |
| **Alt+Shift / Alt+Ctrl** | Same targets, but grab whatever's there even if an ingredient is completely missing |

Bulk pulls think in **whole crafts and keep the recipe's ratios**: a book
(3 paper + 1 leather) with 64 paper but only 3 leather pulls 9 paper +
3 leather — never a useless pile of one ingredient. Missing-but-craftable
ingredients open their native AE2 / Refined Storage / Integrated Terminals
popup pre-filled with exactly the gap.

### 🛈 Tooltip upgrades

- New **"Current stock can make: N"** line — how many of the result your
  storage's stock supports right now (stock only, autocraft not counted).
- Compact hints for the modifiers and the Alt override, showing your actual
  bound keys.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Pulling a single item from a full stack in a container no longer grabs
  the whole stack.
- A bulk click that can't complete a single craft now plays the failure
  animation instead of silently doing nothing.

### ⚠️ Compatibility

- Network protocol bumped — **server and client both need 0.7.0** when
  playing multiplayer.
- Shift+Click on the recipe button changed meaning (was "pull in-stock" —
  that's now **Alt+Click**).
